From classrooms designed for curiosity to learning that connects with the real world, our Open House is a chance to see how every day at Nava is shaped around the learner.

Venue: Ekya Nava, Panathur

Date: 26 September 2026

Time: 10:00 AM – 11:30 AM

Come curious. Leave with a glimpse of what learning can become.
#EkyaNava #OpenHouse #Panathur #BangaloreSchools

Give six-year-olds some cardboard, colour, and time, and watch what happens. ✨
Our Early Years students turned simple materials into kaleidoscopes, discovering how the same pieces can create a completely different picture with every turn.

Sometimes, learning is simply about looking again and seeing something new.

📍Ekya Nava, Panathur • Varthur

Knowing how technology works is one thing. Using it to make something is another.

The Making Pathway puts tools into children’s hands and ideas into the real world. From sketching and problem-solving to 3D printing and building, every creation begins with a question and grows through trying, failing, and trying again.

Because the real learning happens when an idea becomes something you can hold.
